mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.created_at, p.title AS target_title, p.cover_image AS target_image, p.min_price AS target_price FROM favorites f LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.created_at, p.title AS target_title, p.cover_image AS target_image, p.min_price AS target_price FROM favorites f LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY f.id DESC
